id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_150.pack|cs_: "What are you doing loitering by the docks, Erik?
"None of your business. So? Did you get the Orb or what?
"We did! And all because I can spot a phony a mile off! You can thank me later!
"Ach, it's nothing, lassie. I just cannae stop wondering who the handsome young fellow that put Krystalinda up to this might be...
"He'd have to be very important to wear the same pendant as the mighty Hendrik. Could it be Mordegon himself?
"I wish I knew, Serena. Well, standing around guessing won't do us any good. We've a Tree of Life to be getting to.
"Come on, you horrible lot. This adventure isnae over yet. Onward to Yggdrasil!
"C-Crivens! Heh heh. How, how, how did that get there?
"Is this what you were so engrossed in back at the Library, Rab? I thought you said it was a spellbook!
"Another one for the collection, eh? And I thought you'd finally got over your little obsession...
"Sir Rab, you have been caught red-handed! And red-faced!
"And after your rousing speech too. Talk about mortifying...
"B-B-B-But-! Wait! Ye don't understand! I only read them for the articles!
